messages:
prod-monitor: :rotating_light: ALERT — SmartRouting quality signal breached for policy 'economic-route' (1992468000). Quality delta +4.3σ, affected model variant 'gen-legacy-quant'. See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/quality/smart-routing?panel=policy-economic-route

incident-bot: Pager dispatched to @oncall-anna for P0 — 'economic-route sending traffic to low-cost quantized variant; customer quality regressions'. Escalation: oncall -> eng-sre -> ml-ops.

oncall-anna: on it. pinging eng-sre + ml-ops. Can someone confirm if this is a routing policy change or model regression?

eng-sre-bob: I see routing traffic graph — 85% of requests for a set of routes were shifted to gen-legacy-quant starting ~1992467900. Error/quality complaints up. Pulling logs now.

ml-ops-raj: quick metric snapshot: hallucination_rate by model: gen-v2-standard=0.7%, gen-legacy-quant=7.8% (past 10m). Perplexity avg jump x3 for affected requests. Also seeing a drop in semantic-match scores for reranker.

eng-platform-maya: capacity note — gen-v2-standard has limited hot capacity in us-east-1; full shift may increase latency if we don't scale. We can route to gen-v2-standard in us-west-2 as a short-term mitigation.

support-julia: heard from two paying customers (TID-3342, TID-3347) about nonsense completions in prod. Both are reporting 10–20% of calls returning unusable text. Customers are asking for ETA.

oncall-anna: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) disable 'economic-route' policy 2) pin affected routes to gen-v2-standard 3) scale cross-region capacity if needed 4) message customers and follow up with postmortem. Approving if no objections.

eng-sre-bob: +1. I'll run the disable and pin commands.

eng-sre-bob: running: ```bash
# disable policy
redwoodctl routing update-policy --id economic-route --state disabled
# set default model for route group 'chat-core'
redwoodctl route set-default --route-group chat-core --model gen-v2-standard --weight 1.0
```

eng-sre-bob: command output: ```
Policy economic-route: state -> disabled (ok)
Route chat-core: default model -> gen-v2-standard (ok)
Traffic re-evaluation started
```

ml-ops-raj: after the change (10m window) — gen-legacy-quant traffic down to 2% of baseline, gen-v2-standard increased. Quality metrics trending back toward baseline: hallucination_rate for affected set back to 1.0% and semantic-match recovering.

eng-platform-maya: spun up cross-region capacity in us-west-2 to handle the delta: ```bash
redwoodctl capacity create --region us-west-2 --pool standard --gpus 8 --labels emergency-relief
```

eng-platform-maya: capacity create response: pool 'standard-emergency-relief' available, autoscaling enabled. Latency stable at 95th=210ms.

support-julia: customer updates sent for TID-3342 and TID-3347: "We detected a routing configuration issue that sent some requests to a low-cost model variant. We’ve rerouted traffic and are monitoring quality; full update in 2 hours."

pm-lena: creating incident page and customer impact summary for execs. Please drop root cause notes here.

ml-ops-raj: preliminary root cause: cost signal thresholds for 'economic-route' were unintentionally lowered by a recent infra PR (https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pull/3456). The PR changed the parameter `cost_threshold_usd_per_1k` from 0.02 -> 0.002 for test convenience, and it leaked into prod due to missing env override. This caused the policy to prefer the quantized variant.

eng-sre-bob: confirmed — roll of config shows the change deployed at 1992467880. Correlates with traffic shift.

oncall-anna: Action items captured: [A] revert PR 3456 config change (ml-ops) [B] add integration test to prevent cost_threshold < 0.01 (eng-platform) [C] postmortem (owner: pm-lena) [D] run a 24h quality regression job across canary prompts (ml-ops).

ml-ops-raj: I reverted the config and pushed a hotfix: ```bash
git revert 2a7c9f (routing: temp test cost_threshold change)
redwoodctl config apply --env prod --file routing-hotfix.yaml
```

ml-ops-raj: hotfix applied — validation shows cost_threshold back to 0.02. Also queued PR to add CI check that disallows < 0.01 in prod configs.

eng-sre-bob: monitoring: end-to-end quality for affected routes back within SLOs. No new customer complaints in last 15m.

oncall-anna: handing off to eng-sre for monitoring window. I'm standing down from pager but remain on slack for escalation. @eng-sre-bob you own until next rotation.

eng-sre-bob: ack — I'll monitor for 2h and reopen if anything regresses. Adding runbook note: immediate mitigation = disable economic-route + pin to non-quantized model (documented).

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (1992468560). Postmortem required within 48h.

pm-lena: draft postmortem in #product/incidents once we have logs and timeline. Preliminary severity: Sev2 (customer impact localized to subset of routes, mitigated quickly).

support-julia: follow-up to customers will include timeline, root cause, and ETA for safeguards. Sending now. :thumbsup:

prod-monitor: closing alert (quality signal restored)."
